thag10.3:1.1: Anāgataṃ yo paṭigacca passati hitañ ca atthaṃ ahitañ ca taṃ dvayaṃ viddesino tassa hitesino vā randhaṃ na passanti samekkhamānā. || ||
thag10.3:2.1: ānāpānasatī yassa paripuṇṇā subhāvitā anupubbaṃ paricitā yathā buddhena desitā, so 'maṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti abbhā mutto va candimā. || ||
thag10.3:3.1: odātaṃ vata me cittaṃ appamāṇaṃ subhāvitaṃ nibbiddhaṃ paggahītañ ca sabbā obhāsate disā. || ||
thag10.3:4.1: jīvatevāpi sappañño api vittaparikkhayā, paññāya ca alābhena vittavāpi na jīvati. || ||
thag10.3:5.1: paññā sutavinicchinī, paññā kittisilokavaddhanī, paññāsahito naro idha api dukkhesu sukhāni vindati. || ||
thag10.3:6.1: nāyaṃ ajjatano dhammo n' acchero na pi abbhuto: yattha jāyetha mīyetha; tattha kiṃ viya abbhutaṃ. || ||
thag10.3:7.1: anantaraṃ hi jātassa jīvitā maraṇaṃ dhuvaṃ; jātā jātā marantīdha, evaṃdhammā hi pāṇino. || ||
thag10.3:8.1: na h' etad atthāya matassa hoti yaṃ jīvitatthaṃ paraporisānaṃ matamhi ruṇṇaṃ, na yaso na lokyaṃ, na vaṇṇitaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇehi. || ||
thag10.3:9.1: cakkhuṃ sarīraṃ upahanti roṇṇaṃ, nihīyatī vaṇṇabalaṃ matī ca, ānandino tassa divā bhavanti, hitesino nāssa sukhī bhavanti. || ||
thag10.3:10.1: tasmā hi iccheyya kule vasante medhāvino c' eva bahussute ca, yesaṃ hi paññāvibhavena kiccaṃ taranti nāvāya nadiṃ va puṇṇan ti. || || Mahākappino thero.
